children: Leslie’s is reportedly preparing to file for Chapter 11 bankruptcy and hand over control of the business to lenders who are providing ~$100M in financial support.
According to Bloomberg, the company will declare bankruptcy as soon as next week.

A group of lenders will provide ~$100M in debtor-in-possession financing to fund operations through the bankruptcy. The company will then hand over the business to the lenders in return for turning $750M in debt into equity.
